Battle map · two carriers · three lanes

Kestrel Reach

A symmetric two-carrier arena. Asteroid and wreckage fields pack tightly enough to wall off three navigable lanes end to end, with looser cover scattered inside them. The sun is an actual light source, not a painted highlight: every prop is baked once per light direction and per falloff tier, then placed with the pair that matches its real bearing and distance to the sun — the same trick that bakes a ship once per facing. The layout has 180° rotational symmetry, so neither side gets the better ground.
